sections.h2: Reinsurance is 94% of GIFT IFSC's FY2024-25 insurance book

chart.title: Reinsurance premium dwarfs direct premium written in GIFT IFSC
chart.sub: Premium written in FY2024-25, $ million, summed across four quarters.
chart.source: IFSCA quarterly statistical bulletin, Jan-Mar 2025 edition (unaudited).

sections.means: Reinsurance is the overwhelming share of the centre's insurance business, while direct insurance is a small sideline.
sections.todo: Describe GIFT IFSC as a reinsurance centre rather than an offshore insurance hub until direct business grows.

sections.h2: Direct premium peaked at $3.96M in Oct-Dec 2024 and never passed $4M

chart.title: Direct premium stayed between $2.42M and $3.96M in every quarter
chart.sub: Direct premium written by IFSC Insurance Offices per quarter, $ million.
chart.source: IFSCA quarterly statistical bulletin, Jan-Mar 2025 edition (unaudited).

sections.means: Direct premium is small and uneven from quarter to quarter, not a steady retail build-up.
sections.todo: Track direct premium quarter by quarter in the regulator's later bulletins before calling the direct segment growing.

sections.h2: Reinsurance premium ran $44.54M to $58.15M in every quarter

chart.title: Reinsurance premium is the bulk of premium in each quarter of FY2024-25
chart.sub: Reinsurance premium written by IFSC Insurance Offices per quarter, $ million.
chart.source: IFSCA quarterly statistical bulletin, Jan-Mar 2025 edition (unaudited).

sections.means: Reinsurance drives the centre's insurance volume every quarter, though the Jan-Mar 2025 figure is understated by a printed footnote.
